```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(moderndive)
library(fishualize)
```

A model using <https://github.com/PsyTeachR/introdataviz> where x axis is the joint number, and y axis is the score we use something like the example <https://psyteachr.github.io/introdataviz/advanced-plots.html>

```{r}
all <- read.csv("M2DataISMRcsv.csv")
all <- all|>
  group_by(Model)
```

```{r}
rmse_plot <- ggplot(all, aes(x = Joint, y = val_rmse, fill = Model)) +
  introdataviz::geom_split_violin(alpha = .5, trim = FALSE, scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = .25, alpha = .8, fatten = NULL, show.legend = FALSE) +
  #stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange", show.legend = F, 
               #position = position_dodge(.5)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Joint", labels = c("0","1","2","4","5","6","7")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "RMSE", breaks = seq(0, 800, 100), limits = c(0, 500)) +
  scale_fill_fish_d(option = "Antennarius_commerson", name = "Model")+
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("violin_plot_rmse.png", plot = rmse_plot, width = 12, height = 6)
print(rmse_plot)

```

```{r}
nrmse_plot <- ggplot(all, aes(x = Joint, y = val_nrmse, fill = Model)) +
  introdataviz::geom_split_violin(alpha = .5, trim = FALSE, scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = .25, alpha = .8, fatten = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = signif(after_stat(y), 3)),
    position = position_dodge(.71),
    vjust = -1,
    size = 2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Joint", labels = c("0","1","2","4","5","6","7")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "NRMSE", breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_fish_d(option = "Antennarius_commerson", name = "Model")+
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("violin_plot_nrmse.png", plot = nrmse_plot, width = 12, height = 6)
print(nrmse_plot)
```

```{r}
M1_data <- all_3|>
  group_by(Model)|>
  filter(Model == "M1")|>
  select(fold,val_nrmse,Joint)

M2_data <- all_3|>
  group_by(Model)|>
  filter(Model == "M2")|>
  select(fold,val_nrmse,Joint)

M3_data <- all_3|>
  group_by(Model)|>
  filter(Model == "M3")|>
  select(fold,val_nrmse,Joint)
```

```{r}
summary_df_2 <- data.frame(
  fold = M1_data$fold,
  Joint = M1_data$Joint, 
  nrmse_M1 = M1_data$val_nrmse,
  nrmse_M2 = M2_data$val_nrmse,
  NRMSE_diff = M2_data$val_nrmse - M1_data$val_nrmse,
  abs_NRMSE_diff = abs(M2_data$val_nrmse - M1_data$val_nrmse)
)


summary_df_3 <- data.frame(
  fold = M1_data$fold,
  Joint = M1_data$Joint, 
  nrmse_M1 = M1_data$val_nrmse,
  nrmse_M3 = M3_data$val_nrmse,
  NRMSE_diff = M3_data$val_nrmse - M1_data$val_nrmse,
  abs_NRMSE_diff = abs(M3_data$val_nrmse - M1_data$val_nrmse)
  )
```

```{r}
M2_M1_data <- summary_df_2|>
  select(Joint,NRMSE_diff, abs_NRMSE_diff)

M3_M1_data <- summary_df_3|>
  select(Joint,NRMSE_diff, abs_NRMSE_diff)

combined_df <- bind_rows(
  "M2-M1" = M2_M1_data, 
  "M3-M1" = M3_M1_data, 
  .id = "Model"
)
```

```{r}
diff_nrmse_plot <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = Joint, y = NRMSE_diff, fill = Model)) +
  introdataviz::geom_split_violin(alpha = .5, trim = FALSE, scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = .25, alpha = .8, fatten = NULL, show.legend = FALSE) +
  #stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange", show.legend = F, 
  #position = position_dodge(.5)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Joint", labels = c("0","1","2","4","5","6","7")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "NRMSE diff", breaks = seq(-0.2,0.4,0.2), limits = c(-0.2, 0.4)) +
  scale_fill_fish_d(option = "Antennarius_commerson", name = "Model")+
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("violin_plot_diff_nrmse.png", plot = diff_nrmse_plot, width = 12, height = 6)
print(diff_nrmse_plot)
```
